news.title: Federal prosecutors: Clase told bettor to send money to Dominican Republic
news.summary: Emmanuel Clase asked an associate who had won nearly $10,000 betting on the Guardians closer's first pitch the previous night to "send some of that to the [Dominican Republic]," according to evidence ...

news.title: Yankees' Bednar, Twins' Jeffers accept $23.15M qualifying offer to return
news.summary: Yankees closer David Bednar and Twins catcher Ryan Jeffers accepted the qualifying offer, returning to their respective teams on a one-year deal worth $23.15M.

news.title: Pitching-needy White Sox, May agree to 3-year, $52.5M contract
news.summary: The White Sox and free agent starting pitcher Dustin May have agreed on a 3-year, $52.5M contract. The right-hander went 7-9 with a 4.70 ERA last season.

news.title: Hitters benefited from checked-swing reviews in minor league testing
news.summary: The introduction of robot umpire appeals for checked-swing calls in the Triple-A Pacific Coast League this year led to lower swing-and-miss rates on breaking and off-speed pitches.

news.title: Posey, Lester among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot
news.summary: Buster Posey and Jon Lester are among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot, while former players Chase Utley and Andy Pettitte are among the 13 holdover candidates.

news.title: D-backs' Lawlar expected to be ready for regular season after elbow surgery
news.summary: Diamondbacks outfielder Jordan Lawlar had internal brace surgery on his right elbow earlier in the offseason and is expected to be ready around the scheduled start of the regular season.

news.title: Sources: Reliever Hill, Yankees agree to $2.25M contract
news.summary: Left-hander Tim Hill is staying with the Yankees, agreeing to a one-year, $2.25 million contract, sources told ESPN.
